title: JSON templates
supports: Opened with WebFetch. JSON templates list the sections a page renders; up to 25 sections per template, up to 50 blocks per section, up to 1,000 JSON templates per theme

title: Horizon: 10 new free themes by Shopify
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Dated 21 May 2025: Horizon is a set of 10 free Shopify themes built with theme blocks

title: Editing theme code
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Duplicate the theme before editing; the per-file Timeline restores whole files only, has finite history, no history for assets and cannot recover deleted files; code changes that conflict with a theme update are removed in the updated copy

title: Performance best practices for Shopify themes
supports: Opened with WebFetch. image_url and image_tag, fetchpriority on the LCP image, never lazy-load the LCP image, defer scripts, preload only one or two resources, avoid apps that game Lighthouse, Theme Check flags heavy bundles, Theme Store Lighthouse score of 60

title: Audit and remove third-party scripts
supports: Opened with WebFetch. How to inventory scripts, that uninstalling an app does not always remove its theme code, and where leftover code hides (layout/theme.liquid, snippets, render and include tags, page source)

title: Apps in the online store
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Theme app extensions do not edit theme code and are required for new App Store apps; leftover code takes a theme off its upgrade path; script tags cannot be created or updated after 1 October 2026 and stop being added to storefronts on 1 March 2027

title: Theme Store requirements
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Theme Store minimum average Lighthouse scores (performance 60, accessibility 90) on home, collection and product pages, contrast ratios and a 24 by 24 CSS pixel touch target

title: Web performance dashboard
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The admin report shows LCP, INP and CLS from real visits over 30 days at the 75th percentile, with thresholds, annotations for app installs and theme changes, a delay of up to 36 hours and 90 days of history

title: Web Vitals
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Core Web Vitals and their good thresholds (LCP 2.5 s, INP 200 ms, CLS 0.1) at the 75th percentile; INP replaced FID in 2024

title: Collaborator accounts
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Four-digit request code, roles with only the needed permissions, no Administrator role for collaborators, two-step authentication, expiry after 90 days without a login, permanent removal

title: Store permissions
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The Themes permission includes changing and publishing themes; Edit code is separate; many permissions such as Orders and Products have view-only options

title: Authorizing access for AI tools
supports: Opened with WebFetch. AI tool connectors get read-only or write access, are capped by the approving user's permissions, cannot be reduced after approval without reinstalling, and are revoked by uninstalling; lists supported AI tools

title: Adding store policies
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Policy types (return, privacy, terms, shipping, legal notice, contact, subscription), automated policies, links in the checkout footer, the merchant's responsibility for accuracy

title: Preparing to launch your store
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Test orders, Shopify Payments test mode, preview, plan, store address and payment method required before launch, removing the password page

title: Metafields
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Metafields extend Shopify's data model; definitions add validated fields; themes with dynamic sources connect them in the theme editor, vintage themes need code

title: Shopify Scripts will be deprecated on June 30, 2026
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Scripts could not be edited or published after 15 April 2026 and stopped running on 30 June 2026; Shopify Functions replace them

title: Upgrading to checkout extensibility
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Additional scripts became view-only on 28 August 2025; non-Plus stores had until 26 August 2026 to upgrade Thank you and Order status pages

title: Schedule and test storefront changes with Rollouts
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Dated 31 March 2026: schedule theme changes, end dates that revert a promotion, A/B tests against the current theme; Basic plan and above, market targeting on Advanced and Plus

title: European Price Indication Directive
supports: Opened with WebFetch. EEA price reductions must show the lowest price in the previous 30 days or more; compare-at price use, per-market display settings, metafields or theme statements for frequent discounts

title: Customer privacy settings
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Automated privacy settings on new stores, cookie banner for UK and EEA visitors with opt-in consent, data sharing opt-out page, privacy policy needed first, third-party banner regions must match

title: A new era for inclusion begins: the EAA enters into force
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Published 27 June 2025: from 28 June 2025 the European Accessibility Act requires accessible e-commerce platforms, among other products and services

title: Providing clear and accurate information about prices: summary (CMA209)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Updated 7 January 2026: total price including unavoidable fees, how to show delivery charges, drip pricing is illegal, fines up to 10% of turnover or £300,000, whichever is greater

title: Guidance on Web Accessibility and the ADA
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Dated 18 March 2022: the ADA applies to the web offerings of businesses open to the public; no detailed technical regulation; WCAG named as helpful guidance

title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
supports: Opened with WebFetch. W3C Recommendation, version dated 12 December 2024; contrast minimum 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for large text

title: Cart abandonment rate statistics
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Average documented cart abandonment of 70.22% across 50 studies (2006 to 2025), reasons for abandoning checkout, and Baymard's estimate of conversion gains from fixing checkout usability

title: UX Guidelines for Ecommerce Product Pages (Katie Sherwin, 2019)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Product pages must answer shoppers' questions: front-loaded descriptions, several images, full price and shipping details, consistent options, honest reviews, stock status and clear add-to-cart feedback

title: Shopify Editions Summer '25
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Horizon themes built on theme blocks, AI Generate blocks and themes, theme editor changes, Sidekick, the Shopify.dev MCP server and Storefront MCP

title: Vodafone: a 31% improvement in LCP increased sales by 8%
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Published 17 March 2021: an A/B test where the faster page (31% better LCP) had 8% more sales, 15% better lead-to-visit and 11% better cart-to-visit rates

title: Milliseconds make millions
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Study commissioned by Google, run by 55 and Deloitte on 37 brand sites at the end of 2019: a 0.1 second mobile speed improvement was associated with 8.4% more retail conversions

title: Gymshark customer story, by Nick Winkler
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Vendor-published account, updated 29 August 2018: Gymshark's earlier site was offline for about eight hours on Black Friday, an estimated $143,000 in lost sales, blamed on a bug in an app the company was not using; the move to Shopify
